text: 你埋葬了诺曼，心里清楚是自己说服他参加这次远征的。
你暂且压下这个念头，回到洞穴里的猿人尸体旁。它是极其珍贵的标本。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 341
text: You bury Norman’s body, all too aware that you persuaded him to follow you on this expedition.
Putting aside that thought, you return to the dead ape-man in the cave. It is an incredible specimen.
